scripts.dev: npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w @whatsapp-ai/api" "npm run dev -w @whatsapp-ai/bot-worker" "npm run dev -w @whatsapp-ai/frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/shared && npm run dev -w @whatsapp-ai/frontend
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/shared && npm run dev -w @whatsapp-ai/api
scripts.dev:bot-worker: npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/shared && npm run dev -w @whatsapp-ai/bot-worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/shared && npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/api && npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/bot-worker && npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @whatsapp-ai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @whatsapp-ai/api && npm run typecheck -w @whatsapp-ai/bot-worker && npm run typecheck -w @whatsapp-ai/frontend
scripts.build:win: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})}catch(e){}" && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/lib',{recursive:true})" && copy pkg-loader.cjs dist\pkg-loader.cjs && copy index.js dist\lib\index.js && if exist util.js copy util.js dist\lib\util.js && if exist gcal.js copy gcal.js dist\lib\gcal.js && if exist fs-json.js copy fs-json.js dist\lib\fs-json.js && npx pkg -t node18-win-x64 -o dist\whatsapp-ai.exe dist\pkg-loader.cjs --assets dist\lib\**\* --assets dist\bin\**\* --assets node_modules\puppeteer-core\**\*
scripts.build:linux: rimraf dist && mkdir -p dist/lib && cp index.js dist/lib/index.js 2>/dev/null ||: && cp util.js dist/lib/util.js 2>/dev/null ||: && cp gcal.js dist/lib/gcal.js 2>/dev/null ||: && cp fs-json.js dist/lib/fs-json.js 2>/dev/null ||: && npx pkg -t node18-linux-x64 -o dist/whatsapp-ai dist/pkg-loader.cjs --assets dist/lib/**/* --assets dist/bin/**/* --assets node_modules/puppeteer-core/**/*
scripts.build:mac: rimraf dist && mkdir -p dist/lib && cp index.js dist/lib/index.js 2>/dev/null ||: && cp util.js dist/lib/util.js 2>/dev/null ||: && cp gcal.js dist/lib/gcal.js 2>/dev/null ||: && cp fs-json.js dist/lib/fs-json.js 2>/dev/null ||: && npx pkg -t node18-macos-x64 -o dist/whatsapp-ai dist/pkg-loader.cjs --assets dist/lib/**/* --assets dist/bin/**/* --assets node_modules/puppeteer-core/**/*
scripts.build:all: npm run build:win && npm run build:linux && npm run build:mac
